masthead.purpose: The name on the home page, cut to the column width.

hero.purpose: Broadsheet headings: the clinic band's title and inner pages' mastheads.

figure.purpose: Reserved for owner-approved metrics; unused so far.

h1.purpose: Section titles site-wide and the hero's headline line.

h2.purpose: Case-study section headings, under an ink rule.

shadows.name: e1
shadows.purpose: Faintest lift. Transparent in dark mode.

shadows.name: e2
shadows.purpose: Product pictures, drawn dashboards, solid-tier chrome. Transparent in dark mode.

shadows.name: e3
shadows.purpose: Panels: the command palette and appearance panel. Transparent in dark mode.

shadows.name: glass-frosted
shadows.value: inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-edge), inset 0 0 0 0.5px var(--glass-hairline), 0 0 0 0.5px var(--glass-rim), 0 1px 2px var(--glass-rim), 0 calc(var(--glass-lift) * 0.3) var(--glass-lift) calc(var(--glass-lift) * -0.3) var(--glass-shade), 0 2px 6px var(--glass-shade-near)
shadows.purpose: Frosted glass chrome; blur 12/20/32 px by elevation with saturate(170%).

motion.name: dur-micro
motion.purpose: Hover colour, button press. 0ms under reduced motion.

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.purpose: Glass transitions, root cross-fade. 0ms under reduced motion.

motion.name: dur-base
motion.purpose: General state changes. 120ms under reduced motion.

motion.name: dur-slow
motion.purpose: The ceiling: view-transition groups. 120ms under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action in a group, e.g. View CV.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding-inline: 20px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease, transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background-color: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-accent-ink); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: var(--color-accent-strong); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting actions next to the primary, e.g. Selected work.
components.html: Selected work
components.css: .ds-btn2 { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding-inline: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong); border-radius: 12px; background-color: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-ink); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 120ms ease, transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn2:hover { background-color: var(--color-well); } .ds-btn2:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn2:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Link
components.description: Accent means this goes somewhere; the underline fades in on hover.
components.css: .ds-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; color: var(--color-accent); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: transparent; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; border-radius: 6px; transition: text-decoration-color 120ms ease; } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Pill
components.description: One floating glass pill: monogram, text items, search and appearance.
components.html: CMWorkAboutCV
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px; border-radius: 28px; color: var(--color-ink); background-color: light-dark(oklch(1 0 0 / 0.72), oklch(0.25 0.012 250 / 0.76)); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(170%); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(170%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 light-dark(oklch(1 0 0 / 0.95), oklch(1 0 0 / 0.26)), inset 0 0 0 0.5px light-dark(oklch(1 0 0 / 0.5), oklch(1 0 0 / 0.1)), 0 0 0 0.5px light-dark(oklch(0.25 0.02 250 / 0.16), oklch(0 0 0 / 0.55)), 0 8px 28px -8px light-dark(oklch(0.25 0.03 250 / 0.2), oklch(0 0 0 / 0.5)); } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 999px; color: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 120ms ease; } .ds-nav-mono { width: 44px; padding: 0; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-item[aria-current], .ds-nav-item:hover { background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-ink) 9%, transparent); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Spec Sheet
components.description: Facts as label and value on hairlines; replaces chips for logistics and project facts.
components.css: .ds-specs { margin: 0; } .ds-specs > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 7.5em minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 16px; align-items: baseline; padding-block: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong); } .ds-specs > div:first-child { padding-top: 0; } .ds-specs dt { color: var(--color-muted); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-specs dd { margin: 0; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Toast
components.description: A brief confirmation, e.g. Email copied. Glass, pill-shaped.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: inline-block; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--color-ink); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; background-color: light-dark(oklch(1 0 0 / 0.72), oklch(0.25 0.012 250 / 0.76)); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(170%); backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(170%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 light-dark(oklch(1 0 0 / 0.95), oklch(1 0 0 / 0.26)), 0 0 0 0.5px light-dark(oklch(0.25 0.02 250 / 0.16), oklch(0 0 0 / 0.55)), 0 5px 16px -5px light-dark(oklch(0.25 0.03 250 / 0.2), oklch(0 0 0 / 0.5)); }

components.name: Mat
components.description: A neutral board around strongly coloured screenshots and photos, with concentric corners.
components.css: .ds-mat { --pad: clamp(8px, 1.6vw, 16px); padding: var(--pad); border-radius: calc(12px + var(--pad)); background-color: var(--color-well); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-line); } .ds-mat-pic { aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; border-radius: 12px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(0.55 0.15 280), oklch(0.65 0.18 340)); }

narrative.overview:
The site is set like a newspaper's front page. The name is a masthead cut to the width of the column. A full-strength rule sits under it, and the facts are laid out as a spec sheet of labels and values on hairlines, not as chips or cards. One self-hosted typeface, a cool 12-step neutral and a single deep teal carry everything. Colour is kept for meaning: the accent says "this goes somewhere", and status colours appear only in data.

There is one dramatic surface, the full-bleed night band on the home page that presents the BodyMed Hub. A soft three-colour aurora sits behind each masthead, and glass is reserved for floating chrome. Everything else is flat and quiet, with generous space. Motion is short (300 ms ceiling) and turns off with reduced motion. The theme follows the system, can be forced light or dark, and every colour is defined for both modes at once with light-dark().
keyCharacteristics: A masthead name sized to its column, over a full-strength ink rule.
Facts shown as a spec sheet on hairlines, never as tag chips.
One family (Inter Variable), three weights (400, 500, 600), a fluid scale of about 1.25.
A cool neutral (hue 250) with one deep teal accent (hue 200), in light and dark.
Flat by default: shadows only on product pictures and floating chrome, and none in dark mode.
Glass on the nav, ⌘K palette, appearance panel and toasts only, in three tiers that each work on their own.
Product screenshots stay light in both themes, as on a product page.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal is for the primary action, links, focus and selection. If it isn't one of those, it isn't teal.

rules.name: The Never-Purple Rule
rules.body: The aurora and the night band use teal, blue and green only.

rules.name: The Roles-Not-Steps Rule
rules.body: Components use canvas, surface, well, line, ink, muted and so on, never n1–n12 directly.

rules.name: The Three Weights Rule
rules.body: 400, 500 and 600 only. Nothing lighter than 400, nothing heavier than 600.

rules.name: The Colour-Not-Weight Rule
rules.body: Hover changes colour or opacity, never weight, so nothing shifts.

rules.name: The Typographer's Marks Rule
rules.body: Real quotes and dashes (’ “ ” – —), text-wrap: balance on headings, pretty on paragraphs, tabular figures for numbers.

rules.name: The Chrome-Only Glass Rule
rules.body: Glass goes on the nav, ⌘K, the appearance panel, toasts and the small clear note in the night band. Never behind body text. At most two glass surfaces on screen at rest.

rules.name: The Pictures-Float Rule
rules.body: Only pictures and chrome cast shadows. Text blocks and sections never do.

dos: Do take every size, gap, colour, radius and shadow from src/styles/tokens.css; add a token before using a new value.
Do keep the accent for the primary action, links, focus and selection.
Do show facts as a spec sheet on hairlines.
Do keep touch targets at least 44 px (spacing-tap).
Do keep UI motion at 300 ms or less, using --dur-* and --ease-*, so reduced motion can retune it in one place.
Do give every glass surface its solid fallback, and use the panel tint if it needs muted text.
Do keep product screenshots and drawn dashboards light in both themes, on a mat when their own colours are strong.
donts: Don't use purple, gradient text, or a glow orb as decoration; the aurora is teal, blue and green, behind mastheads only.
Don't put glass behind body text, or put muted or accent-coloured text on the nav pill.
Don't use a font weight outside 400–600, or change weight on hover.
Don't box everything in cards; cards are only for things that are clickable.
Don't use status colours outside data and draft markers.
Don't add shadows in dark mode or to text sections.
Don't use n1–n12 directly in components.
